name: WLF_LEARN_RELATION_RECORDS
description: Table to store learn organization relation access information.

columns.name: LEARN_RELATION_RECORD_ID
columns.description: System generated unique identifier.

columns.name: LEARN_RELATION_RECORD_NUMBER
columns.description: Learn Relation Record Number

columns.name: RELATION_ID
columns.description: Learn organization relation id

columns.name: LEARN_OBJECT_ID
columns.description: Learn organization object id

columns.name: LEARN_OBJECT_TYPE
columns.description: Learn organization object type.

columns.name: PERSON_ID
columns.description: Person id

columns.name: STATUS
columns.description: This column represents status of the learn relation record {ACTIVE, DELETED}.

columns.name: IN_ELASTIC
columns.description: Indicates if access is processed to security index or not

columns.name: LATEST_PROCESS_ID
columns.description: Learning Organization expansion job latest process id

columns.name: LATEST_PROCESS_DATE
columns.description: Learning Organization expansion job latet process date

columns.name: FIRST_ACTIVATION_DATE
columns.description: Date when this participant became Active the first time

columns.name: STATUS_CHANGE_DATE
columns.description: Date of last status transition

columns.name: ADDED_ON_DATE
columns.description: Indicates the learn relation record active date

columns.name: REMOVED_ON_DATE
columns.description: Indicates the learn relation record removed date

columns.name: CREATED_BY_ID
columns.description: Indicates the person identifier who created the content object.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: ENTERPRISE_ID
columns.description: Identifier of Enterprise, used for multi-tenancy partitioning. Foreign key to HR_ORGANIZATION_UNITS.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
